questionEnglish: What is the atomic number and valency of Carbon?
questionOdia: କାର୍ବନର ପରମାଣୁ କ୍ରମାଙ୍କ (Atomic Number) ଏବଂ ସଂଯୋଜକତା (Valency) କେତେ?
explanation: Carbon has an atomic number of 6 with an electronic configuration of (2,4). Since it has 4 valence electrons, its valency is 4 (tetravalency).

questionEnglish: Which unique property allows Carbon to form long chains and rings by bonding with other carbon atoms?
questionOdia: ଅନ୍ୟ କାର୍ବନ ପରମାଣୁ ସହିତ ବନ୍ଧନ ଗଠନ କରି ଏକ ଦୀର୍ଘ ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳ ବା ବଳୟ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିବାର କାର୍ବନର ସେହି ଅନନ୍ୟ ଗୁଣକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Catenation (ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳନ) is the self-linking property of carbon atoms through covalent bonds to form long, stable structures.

questionEnglish: What type of chemical bonds are predominantly formed by Carbon in its compounds?
questionOdia: କାର୍ବନ ଏହାର ଯୌଗିକଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ରାସାୟନିକ ବନ୍ଧନ ଗଠନ କରିଥାଏ?
explanation: Carbon shares its 4 valence electrons with other atoms to achieve a stable electronic configuration, thereby forming covalent bonds (ସହସଂଯୋଜକ ବନ୍ଧନ).

questionEnglish: Which of the following is the hardest crystalline allotrope of Carbon?
questionOdia: ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି କାର୍ବନର ସବୁଠାରୁ କଠିନ ସ୍ଫଟିକୀୟ ଅପରୂପ (Allotrope)?
explanation: Diamond (ହୀରା) is a three-dimensional network structure of carbon where each atom is bonded to four others, making it the hardest natural substance known.

questionEnglish: Why is Graphite a good conductor of electricity unlike other non-metals?
questionOdia: ଅନ୍ୟ ଅଧାତୁଗୁଡ଼ିକ ତୁଳନାରେ ଗ୍ରାଫାଇଟ୍ (Graphite) ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍‌ର ସୁପରିବାହୀ ହେବାର କାରଣ କଣ?
explanation: In graphite, each carbon atom is bonded to three other carbon atoms, leaving one free valence electron per atom to conduct electricity.

questionEnglish: What is the general chemical formula for the homologous series of Alkanes?
questionOdia: ଆଲକେନ୍ (Alkanes) ସମଜାତୀୟ ଶ୍ରେଣୀର ସାଧାରଣ ରାସାୟନିକ ସଙ୍କେତ କଣ?
explanation: Alkanes are saturated hydrocarbons containing only single bonds, and they follow the general formula C_n H_{2n+2} (e.g., Methane: CH4).

questionEnglish: Hydrocarbons containing at least one carbon-carbon double bond (C=C) are classified as?
questionOdia: କାର୍ବନ-କାର୍ବନ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଅତିକମରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଦ୍ୱିବନ୍ଧ (Double Bond) ଥିବା ହାଇଡ୍ରୋକାର୍ବନକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Alkenes are unsaturated open-chain hydrocarbons that contain a carbon-carbon double bond and follow the general formula C_n H_{2n}.

questionEnglish: What is the name of the functional group present in carboxylic acids?
questionOdia: କାର୍ବୋକ୍ସିଲିକ୍ ଅମ୍ଳରେ (Carboxylic acids) ଥିବା କ୍ରିୟାଶୀଳ ଗ୍ରୁପ୍ ବା ଫଙ୍କସନାଲ୍ ଗ୍ରୁପ୍‌ର ସଙ୍କେତ କଣ?
explanation: The carboxylic acid functional group is represented by -COOH (e.g., Ethanoic acid: CH3COOH).

questionEnglish: Compounds having the same molecular formula but different structural arrangements are called?
questionOdia: ଏକା ପ୍ରକାରର ଆଣବିକ ସଙ୍କେତ କିନ୍ତୁ ଭିନ୍ନ ଗଠନମୂଳକ ସଙ୍କେତ ଥିବା ଯୌଗିକଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Isomers (ସମାବୟବୀ) exhibit different physical or chemical properties due to the variation in the arrangement of atoms in space.

questionEnglish: Which chemical substance is the main constituent of vinegar?
questionOdia: ଭିନେଗାର୍ (Vinegar) ର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ରାସାୟନିକ ଉପାଦାନ କଣ?
explanation: A 5-8% solution of ethanoic acid (acetic acid) in water is commercialized and used as vinegar for preserving food items.
